studio.name: Prignano Games
studio.tagline: Original, craft-first web and installable games.
principles: Original work only — no borrowed names, art, audio, or content.
Kid-safe & privacy-respecting — no analytics, no tracking, local-first progress.
Deterministic core — game rules live in a single tested module, never duplicated.
Fail-closed ops — hard spend caps, allowlisted inputs, secrets stay out of repos.

games.name: Good to Go
games.tagline: Learn to play Go, from your first capture to full 19x19 games.

milestones.title: Build 1: Board, Rules & Stages 1–3

milestones.title: Build 2: Engine, Levels & Problems

milestones.title: Build 3: AI Coach
milestones.summary: Cloudflare Worker, Cloudflare Access allowlist, concept-tagged structured input, output filter, budget caps, privacy page.

milestones.title: Build 4: Online Rooms
